meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位并修复各类运行时故障，从崩溃到内存泄漏
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常遭遇崩溃、泄漏或莫名失败却难以定位根因。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix any runtime failure, from crashes to memory leaks.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face crashes, leaks, or unexplained failures and can't find the root cause.

howto.what: Claude 调试时先读对应运行时的参考资料，再按假设驱动循环：至少 3 个假设并行验证，两轮失败后换角度生成 Oracle；确认根因后用失败测试锁定，最小修复，实际运行系统验收，最后清理日志等痕迹。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 调试某个运行问题（如说“debug this”、“为什么 X 不工作”），或遇到崩溃、静默失败、卡住等问题时触发。任何语言或二进制均适用。

say.text: 帮我 debug 这个崩溃，为什么程序退出了？
say.note: Claude 会先读运行时参考，再进调试循环。

say.text: 为什么接口返回空，但是 HTTP 200？
say.note: 它会检查静默失败模式并定位根因。

say.text: 程序偶尔卡死，帮我排查一下。
say.note: 它先做间歇性故障分诊，再按流程调试。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a hypothesis-driven debug loop: reads runtime references first, forms ≥3 hypotheses, investigates in parallel, spawns Oracles after 2 failed rounds, confirms root cause, locks with a failing test, fixes minimally, QA by actually using the system, and scrubs artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to debug something (e.g., 'debug this', 'why is X not working') or when you face crashes, silent failures, hangs, etc., in any language or binary.

say_en.text: Help me debug this crash — why did the program exit?
say_en.note: Claude starts the hypothesis-driven loop and reads runtime references.

say_en.text: Why is the response empty but HTTP 200?
say_en.note: It checks silent-failure patterns and finds the root cause.
It triages flaky failures first, then runs the debug loop.
